name: investment.strategy_results

list.description: Query native decision tasks for one explicit variant and trigger business-date window.

parameters.name: task-type
parameters.description: Explicit native task variant; one variant is queried at a time.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Inclusive native GMT+08 trigger business day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive native GMT+08 trigger business day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

get.description: Read the complete native decision task root online.

parameters.name: task-type
parameters.description: Explicit native task variant; one variant is queried at a time.

lookup.name: taskId
lookup.description: Native List id, sent as taskId; task-type must match the originating row.

result_identity.description: Exact native taskType and taskId echoes of explicit query context and lookup.

purpose: Inspect native fund or product decision task recommendations and details without executing investments.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native List task identity within taskType.

fields.name: triggerDate
fields.meaning: Native epoch milliseconds; date bounds use GMT+08.

fields.name: taskId
fields.meaning: Native Get identity corresponding to List id.

fields.name: investableFundResultVo
fields.meaning: Unchanged native fund detail and nested currency/date amounts.

identity_description: Native taskType and id; acquisition and cache scopes fix taskType, so SDK deduplication uses native id without deriving a hash.
limitations: List POST JSON /api/increment/decision/task/queryPage.json with fixed tenant GUAPW3SG, explicit taskType, full-day triggerStartDate/triggerEndDate and zero-based rowStart/pageSize. Native total is data.totalCount; rows are data.data.

Qualified request widths are 5000 and 10; neither is a measured backend maximum. Native pageSize=0 metadata is a placeholder, not a request-width echo; completeness uses native total and validated native identities.

Only one task variant is acquired per invocation. Every row must match taskType and native triggerDate must lie in the GMT+08 business-day window. Result time and capture time are not trigger-date bounds.

Native values, precision, unknown fields, operation logs, nested structures, nulls and array order are retained. A recommendation or adoption status does not prove investment execution or realized return.

Only complete nonempty refresh publishes. Empty, failed or incomplete refresh preserves previous saved data; live does not publish. Durable publication requires explicit sync under the declared acquisition contract.
Get POST form /api/increment/decision/task/taskDetail.json sends only taskId. Required task-type validates returned taskType without sending that field. Returned taskId must match lookup.

Get preserves the complete native root and publishes no cache; separately queried children remain unqueried. --live --with-detail composes only selected List rows atomically and preserves saved List data.

examples.title: Read one task
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity get investment.strategy_results TASK_ID --task-type FUND_DECISION_TASK
